To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The Barnett-Lothe and their associated tensors are explicitly expressed in terms of material constants and the direction cosines of the line force, line dislocation and surface wave propagation direction; and (2) The explicit expressions of these tensors are valid for orthotropic materials, in which the planes (or one plane) of material symmetry coincides with one (or the X3 = O) of the coordinate planes.

explicit expressions of Barnett- Lothe tensors and their corresponding associated tensors have been derived for orthotropic materials with material symmetry planes coinciding with the X3 = X1 and X3 = X2 coordinate planes and for orthotropic materials that have only the X3 - X1 coordinate plane coinciding with a material symmetry plane.
the Barnett-Lothe tensor L for orthotropic materials can be expressed in terms of the elastic moduli and that its associated tensor L(v) for line forces is the same as the one for line dislocations.
